source.title: Former champ Samsonova eases back into Washington quarterfinals

description: Liudmila Samsonova, the 2022 Mubadala DC Open champion, returned to her third quarterfinal at the tournament with a straight-sets defeat of Wang Xinyu in the 2026 second round. Samsonova improved to 3-1 against Wang, and reached her first quarterfinal since Abu Dhabi in February.
